q: Is CircoLoco Records owned by Rockstar Games?
a: Partly. Rolling Stone reported in May 2021 that CircoLoco and Rockstar Games co-own the label and would run it as a separate, independent business. The ownership split has not been published.

q: Is "Don't Stop" by Prospa on CircoLoco Records?
a: Yes. It came out April 11, 2025, catalog number CLR015, and builds on a hook from Somethin' For The People's 1997 song "My Love Is the Shhh!".

q: Who is on "Free Your Mind" by Prospa?
a: The title track features Cloonee, and some chart listings also credit Sybil. It opens Prospa's debut album, out on CircoLoco Records June 5, 2026, which also features Josh Baker, RAHH, Kosmo Kint and Murda Beatz.

q: How do I get the CircoLoco Media Sticks in GTA Online?
a: Since Los Santos Tuners (July 20, 2021), four Monday Dreamin' EP sticks - Black, Blue, Violet and Green - are hidden around the map and play on the Media Player. Collecting all four unlocks Seth Troxler's CLR Launch Party mix and a CircoLoco tee.

q: Is the Music Locker a CircoLoco Records club?
a: Nothing ties them together. The Music Locker opened with The Cayo Perico Heist in December 2020, five months before the label was announced, with Moodymann, Keinemusik and Palms Trax as residents.

q: Will GTA 6 have a CircoLoco radio station?
a: Only a leak says so. An unconfirmed clip reported by We Rave You in August 2026 showed a "CircoLoco Records Radio" station, but when Rockstar named its first six stations in October 2026, none of them was CircoLoco's.
DC10 began in the 1990s as a bar run by brothers Deogracias and Antonio Lara Moreno. Italian promoters Antonio Carbonaro and Andrea Pelino came in as partners in 1999 and started CircoLoco.
